page.overview:
Who is Junior?

Junior is the son of Buck and Doe featured in the film . Junior gets his name from his toy in Kenner's The Lost World Series 1 who has the codename of "Junior".

As an infant, Junior exhibited the innate behavior of consuming the food left by his parents at the nest during their brief absences for hunting. But this made him vulnerable to capture by hunters who restrained him well he had called out for his parents. Although he had never encountered humans before, he did not display significant fear, only observing the two humans from his position and continuing to eat.

In Junior's distress, he instinctively attempted to defend himself; by trying to bite the human providing treatment for his injured leg.

When faced; with Ludlow, Junior experienced fear and attempted to flee, seeking safety. His father, recognizing the danger, intervened and incapacitated Ludlow by breaking his leg. With his father's encouragement, Junior mustered the confidence to engage in his first hunting attempt, pouncing on the wounded Ludlow and successfully killing him.
